newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Yabeng cautions on Choice talks.
newsitem.headline: Yabeng cautions on Choice talks.

text.p: Yabeng Investment Holding Co Ltd said on Wednesday it was in negotiations which, if successful, could have an affect on the share price.
Yabeng said it held stakes in Choice Holdings Ltd which on Tuesday advised shareholders it was in talks too.
Yabeng holds 39.12 percent of the Choice preference share capital, an effective 19.56 percent of Choice's issued share capital.
Yabeng also has a significant investment in the share and loan capital of C.I.C. Investments (Pty) Ltd, a subsidiary company managed by Choice which is owned 50:50 by Yabeng and Choice.
